desc: Model removal as a non-crossing matching; even-length segment value = total_sum - 2*sum(smaller half); odd N leaves an odd-index unmatched element splitting into two independent even segments.
Implement O(N log N) two-heap scan to compute value for every even-length prefix and suffix.
Combine prefix/suffix values over valid odd split positions for odd N (whole array for even N).
Produce final stdin/stdout Python solution and verify all 3 public samples (pass), plus reasoning for N=2, all-equal, and monotone edge cases.
